items.verify: - DNS 污染 vs IP 封禁｜Cloudflare Learning / Cloudflare Blog（2026-10-26 查阅）：DNS cache poisoning/spoofing 指解析器缓存错误 IP，用户被导向错误地址；IP blocking 则是阻断连向某 IP 的流量，与域名无关，且可能误伤同 IP 上其他站点 https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/dns/dns-cache-poisoning/ https://blog.cloudflare.com/consequences-of-ip-blocking/
